author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Police arrested the alleged admin of XSS.is, a major cybercrime forum whose trusted escrow service helped power the underground economy. title: XSS.is, The Forum That Ran the Ransomware Supply Chain Is Down. The Market Isn’t

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) adds a SimpleHelp flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added a SimpleHelp flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-48558 (CVSS score v3.1 of 10.0), to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. CVE-2026-48558 is a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in SimpleHelp versions 5.5.15 and earlier and […]
title: U.S. CISA adds SimpleHelp flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hackers stole data from 4.38 million Aflac Japan customers after accessing its systems for 10 days before the breach was detected.
